proposals.primaryEvidenceText: 9691 ma base of singular oblique cases of 1st person pronoun: acc. mā́m, inst. máyā, dat. máhyam, gen. máma, encl. mē. Pa. maṁ, mayā, mayhaṁ, mama; Aś. acc. maṁ, inst. mayā, gen. shah. man. maa, gir. kāl. dh. mama; NiDoc. gen. dat. mama, mahi; Pk. acc. maṁ, mamaṁ, inst. maē, gen. mama, majjhaṁ, Ap. inst. maï˜. — Except in some peripheral NIA. languages a form based for the most part on Pk. inst. maē (with substitution of nominal inst. ending -eṁ < -ēna) has taken the place of old nominative ahám; Gy. eur. me 'I', pal. ắma; Chil. Gau. Sv. Phal. Sh. ma (but Phal. inst. mē, mī), S.srk. mā̃, mū̃; L. maĩ, mε῀ nom. and inst., P. maĩ, WPah.jaun. mē̃ (nom. also hāũ, aũ); Garh. maĩ, mĩ (inst. maĩn), Ku. maĩ, mī (inst. maĩle), N. ma, emph. maĩ (inst. maile), A. maï, B. (vulgar) mui, Or. mu, mũ; OAw. maïṁ nom. and inst.; H. maĩ (inst. maĩne), OMarw. mẽ, M. mī˜, mī. — Other forms: Pr. əm gen.; Tir. masi 'to me'; Kho. ma acc. and gen.; Tor. Sv. mī gen.; K. mĕ dat. inst. abl.; S. encl. -mi 'of, to, by me' < mē, L. encl. -m; WPah.bhad. maĩ inst. (aũ nom.), G. mε῀; Si. mama nom.; — H. mujh obl.; OG. majha dat., M. maj̈ obl., māj̈hā 'my', Ko. majjo. — The genitive is replaced by a declinable adjective with various suffixes: Gaw. mōna, Tir. myāna, K. myônᵘ; — Gy. gr. minro, SEeur. moi̦ó m., mei̦í f., L. maĩḍā, maiḍā; — Ap. mahāriya-, mēra-, WP. mε῀rā, P. merā, WPah. jaun. Garh. Ku. N. mero, A. mohora, mora, Or. mohara, OAw. moraü, H. merā, OMarw. meraü, OG. māharaü, G. mārũ. — See ahám, māmaká-. MAṀH 'give': máhas-². Addenda: ma-: Kho. ma 'me' obl. BKhoT 70; WPah.kṭg. mũ 'I'; Md. ma 'I, me' (gen. ma-ge, dat. mařař). †mámat. †makkaṇa- see matkuṇa-².

proposals.primaryEvidenceText: 5889 tuvám (metr.), tvám 'thou'. 2. Acc. tuvā́m (metr.), tvā́m. 3. Inst. tvā́ 4. Gen. táva. 5. Dat. túbhya(m) RV. 1. Nom.: Pa. tuvaṁ, tvaṁ, NiDoc. tu, tuo, Pk. tumaṁ, tuṁ, taṁ, Gy. eur. tu, pal. ắtu, Ḍ. tu, Ash. tū, Wg. tu, tṳ̄, Pr. iyū, Dm. tu, Tir. tu, tə, ta, Paš. Niṅg. Shum. Gaw. tu, Kal. tū̆, tüi, Kho. tu, Bshk. Tor. Mai. tū, Sv. Phal. Sh. tu, K.rām. pog. kash. tu, S. tū̃, L. P. tũ, WPah.bhad. bhal. pāḍ. paṅ. cur. tū, khaś. tũ, Ku. tū, N. tã, B. Or. Bhoj. tu, OAw. tūṁ, H. OMarw. tū, tū̃, M. tū̃, Ko. tū. — Not all forms come directly < tuvám, e.g. NiDoc. tuo; Pk. tuhaṁ after ahám, Ap. tuhu with -hu from ehu 'this' L. A. Schwarzschild JAOS 80, 15, OA. tuhã; G. tū̃ < OG. taüṁ after haüṁ 'I' Dave GujLg 145. 2. Acc.: Pa. taṁ, Pk. tuvaṁ, tumaṁ, tuṁ, taṁ, Wg. tū. 3. Inst.: Dm. -p as suffix of 2nd sg. pret. (extended to aor.) e.g. kurōp orig. 'it was done by thee' NTS xii 141: cf. Ap. paï˜ < *tvayēna. 4. Gen.: Pa. NiDoc. Pk. tava, Dm. Gaw. tō, B. to ODBL 817, Or. to (perh. rather < toho); — as acc.: Shum. Sh.pales. tō; — as nom.; — Si. tō GS 124 (or < Pk. tuha or even < tuvám). 5. Dat.: Pk. tubbhaṁ, °bha. — Replaced by Pa. tuyhaṁ after máhyam s.v. ma-, Pk. tujjhā̆ (as gen. abl.), A. tazu (gen.), H. tujh (gen. obl.), G. poet. tuja 'thine', M. tuj̈hā; — < contracted *tjjha-: Bshk. čhā̃ 'thine' AO. xviii 231, Tor. čhī, K. ċ- (nom. ċᵃh, acc. dat. ċĕ, inst. ċe, possessive adj. cyônᵘ). — *tuddha- (cf. Ap. tudhra) as gen. obl. in L.poṭh. tuddh and poss. in Gy. eur. tut (for *thud with t- after nom. tu). — Possessive adj. formed with -ra- or -kā̆ra- or -kēra-: Ap. tuhara-, B. Or. tora; — P. H. terā, Ku. N. tero; — G. tārɔ; — Gy. eur. tiro, arm. terav in face of SEeur. toi̦ó, tii̦í is to be connected rather with L. teḍā. Addenda: tuvám: Kho. tu 'thou', obl. ta, dat. tat BKhoT 73, WPah.kṭg. (kc.) tū, tu, poet. tue pl. 'you'; Garh. tu, A. tui, Md. ta.
